headline_marked: Over [[75 family members killed]] in Gaza war, says Ismail Haniyeh's son
headline: Over 75 family members killed in Gaza war, says Ismail Haniyeh's son
summary: Abdul Salam Haniyeh reveals the heavy toll on his family and the Al-Hajj clan during the ongoing conflict in the Gaza Strip.
details: Abdul Salam Haniyeh, son of the late Hamas political bureau chief Ismail Haniyeh, stated that more than 75 close family members have been killed in the war in the Gaza Strip.
He further revealed that approximately 250 members of the larger Al-Hajj clan were killed during the conflict, speaking in an interview with Anadolu Agency.
Abdul Salam recalled that on April 10, 2024, during the first day of Eid al-Fitr, three of Ismail Haniyeh's sons—Mohammad, Hazem, and Amir—and several grandchildren were killed in Israeli strikes.
He described his father as a teacher, mentor, and close friend who taught them to remain humble and stay connected to the needs of ordinary people.

Ismail Haniyeh was killed on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran, while attending the inauguration of President Masoud Pezeshkian. Israel's Defense Minister Israel Katz acknowledged responsibility for the killing in December 2024.
Abdul Salam praised Turkey's political and humanitarian support for Palestinians and expressed hope that mediation by Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey would lead to a successful ceasefire.
He called on the international community to end the Israeli occupation of Gaza and the West Bank, emphasizing that the children of Gaza have a right to live, learn, and have a stable future.
He noted that over 30,000 children have been killed in the war, urging global leaders to turn public support for Palestine into effective political action.
caption:
Over 75 close family members and 250 clan relatives killed.
Abdul Salam Haniyeh shares the devastating personal cost of the Gaza war.

Abdul Salam Haniyeh, son of the late Hamas political bureau chief Ismail Haniyeh, stated that more than 75 close family members have been killed in the war in the Gaza Strip.

He further revealed that approximately 250 members of the larger Al-Hajj clan were killed during the conflict, speaking in an interview with Anadolu Agency.

Abdul Salam recalled that on April 10, 2024, during the first day of Eid al-Fitr, three of Ismail Haniyeh's sons—Mohammad, Hazem, and Amir—and several grandchildren were killed in Israeli strikes.

He described his father as a teacher, mentor, and close friend who taught them to remain humble and stay connected to the needs of ordinary people.

Ismail Haniyeh was killed on July 31, 2024, in Tehran, Iran, while attending the inauguration of President Masoud Pezeshkian. Israel's Defense Minister Israel Katz acknowledged responsibility for the killing in December 2024.

Abdul Salam praised Turkey's political and humanitarian support for Palestinians and expressed hope that mediation by Egypt, Qatar, and Turkey would lead to a successful ceasefire.

He called on the international community to end the Israeli occupation of Gaza and the West Bank, emphasizing that the children of Gaza have a right to live, learn, and have a stable future.

He noted that over 30,000 children have been killed in the war, urging global leaders to turn public support for Palestine into effective political action.

Source: Jamuna TV

headline: Tragedy in Kalabagan: Man kills wife and mother-in-law
summary: The suspect has reportedly fled the scene with his young child after the brutal attack in Dhaka.
details: A man has allegedly killed his wife and mother-in-law in the Kalabagan area of Dhaka.
The victims were attacked with a sharp weapon, according to reports.
Following the crime, the suspect fled the scene, taking his young child with him.
Local authorities have been notified and are investigating the motive behind the double homicide.
